venue.name: Lumby Golf Club (test)
venue.description: Lumby Golf Club is a municipal nine-hole course just east of the village, open since 1963 and known for its unusual sand greens and mountain views. It's a relaxed, no-fuss round for a summer evening, and the property also has a disc golf course for anyone who'd rather throw than swing. Run by volunteers from the golf club society and everyone is welcome no membership needed
venue.description_fr: Le Lumby Golf Club est un parcours municipal de neuf trous situé juste à l'est du village, ouvert depuis 1963 et connu pour ses verts en sable peu communs et ses vues sur les montagnes. C'est une partie détendue et sans prétention pour une soirée d'été, et le terrain compte aussi un parcours de disc golf pour ceux qui préfèrent lancer plutôt que frapper.

rows.label: Good to know
rows.text: Cart and club rentals. Pull carts only no power carts. Cash only. If nobody is in the clubhouse use the honour box by the door. No tee times just come on down. Clubhouse has pop and snacks.

rows.label: Groups
rows.text: Groups of 8 or more: please book ahead. Tournaments and corporate golf for local fundraisers phone the clubhouse to book.
